name: Combined sparsification exact-source gate
on:
  push:
    branches: [integration/conditional-plus6-ci-20261015]
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: paper-formalizations-single-lean-worker
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - name: Fail closed if another repository workflow is active
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 scripts/CombinedPaperCI.py preflight
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: 34bda2f53bb8bd31cb7fb8322bf1499dc002d459
          path: source
      - name: Install exact official release archive
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-lean"
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/releases/download/v4.34.0/lean-4.34.0-linux.tar.zst -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-lean/lean.tar.zst"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-lean"
          echo 'caaa98356098c85dc0fcbbd28e1ec66f39eb6551829972b752ff20e1286b646b  lean.tar.zst' | sha256sum -c -
          sha256sum lean.tar.zst > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/evidence/official-archive.sha256"
          tar --zstd -xf lean.tar.zst
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-lean/lean-4.34.0-linux/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Validate exact source sequentially
        env:
          MATHLIB_CACHE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/mathlib-cache
        run: python3 scripts/CombinedPaperCI.py verify
      - name: Preserve all logs, hashes and audit outputs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: combined-sparsification-${{ github.sha }}
          path: evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error

name: Lean

permissions:

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5

          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          test: "false"

name: Slack sparsification
on:
  push:
    branches: [distance-sparsification-checkpoints]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "false"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
      - name: Build the paper
        run: lake build SlackSparsification
      - name: Audit all declarations
        run: lake env lean 'A Note on Distance-Preserving Graph Sparsification/verification/Audit.lean'
      - name: Independent kernel replay
        run: |
          for f in 'A Note on Distance-Preserving Graph Sparsification/SlackSparsification/'*.lean; do
            m="${f##*/}"
            lake env leanchecker -v "SlackSparsification.${m%.lean}"
          done

name: Integrated plus-six exact-source gate
on:
  push:
    branches: [integration/conditional-plus6-ci-20261015]
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: paper-formalizations-single-lean-worker
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - name: Fail closed if another repository workflow is active
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 scripts/PlusSixIntegrationCI.py preflight
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: c189a4e93786b47c7dbc23146c6b44a5b9cc75dc
          path: source
      - name: Install exact official release archive
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-lean"
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/releases/download/v4.34.0/lean-4.34.0-linux.tar.zst -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-lean/lean.tar.zst"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-lean"
          echo 'caaa98356098c85dc0fcbbd28e1ec66f39eb6551829972b752ff20e1286b646b  lean.tar.zst' | sha256sum -c -
          sha256sum lean.tar.zst > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/evidence/official-archive.sha256"
          tar --zstd -xf lean.tar.zst
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-lean/lean-4.34.0-linux/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Validate exact source sequentially
        env:
          MATHLIB_CACHE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/mathlib-cache
        run: python3 scripts/PlusSixIntegrationCI.py verify
      - name: Preserve all logs, hashes and audit outputs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: integrated-plus6-${{ github.sha }}
          path: evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error

name: Lean
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
          axiom-audit: "true"
          axiom-audit-root: "VFTSpanners"
          axiom-audit-allow: "propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound"
      - name: Check all paper module indexes
        run: bash scripts/CheckModuleIndex.sh
      - name: Audit every declaration in all paper libraries
        run: lake env lean scripts/AxiomAudit.lean
      - name: Replay every project module through the Lean kernel
        run: bash scripts/KernelCheck.sh

name: Lean
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
          axiom-audit: "true"
          axiom-audit-root: "VFTSpanners"
          axiom-audit-allow: "propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound"
      - name: Check all paper module indexes
        run: bash scripts/CheckModuleIndex.sh
      - name: Audit every declaration in all paper libraries
        run: lake env lean scripts/AxiomAudit.lean
      - name: Execute binary covering regression cases
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/verification/BinaryCoverEntrySmoke.lean"
      - name: Replay every project module through the Lean kernel
        run: bash scripts/KernelCheck.sh

      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262

        run: python3 scripts/CheckHeavyPackingBudgetSnapshot.py

name: Graph execution diagnostic
on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - name: Bind all inherited proof sources and new runtime fixture
        run: python3 scripts/CheckGraphExecutionSnapshot.py
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          build-args: "+DirectedFlowCutGap.EncodedSurvivorRestriction +DirectedFlowCutGap.BinaryPortMaterialization"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
          axiom-audit: "false"
      - name: Execute five new graph-body fixture groups
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          runtime_log="$(mktemp)"
          trap 'rm -f "$runtime_log"' EXIT
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/verification/GraphExecutionSmoke.lean" 2>&1 | tee "$runtime_log"
          python3 scripts/CheckGraphExecutionOutput.py "$runtime_log"

        run: lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/ImmutableReferenceSimulation.lean"

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/PackedBooleanConstructor.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/PackedBooleanRead.lean"

name: Lean
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
          axiom-audit: "true"
          axiom-audit-root: "VFTSpanners"
          axiom-audit-allow: "propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound"
      - name: Check all paper module indexes

name: Joint stateful rounding certificate
on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - name: Bind probability proof and inherited source closure
        run: python3 scripts/CheckStatefulRoundingCertificateSnapshot.py
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          build-args: "+DirectedFlowCutGap.StatefulRoundingCertificate"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
          axiom-audit: "false"
      - name: Strictly compile concrete shared-ledger bounded-bit quality
        run: |
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/AllRegimeBoundedTapeLaw.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/StatefulBoundedRoundingQuality.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/StatefulRoundingCertificate.lean"
      - name: Audit every owned declaration in the probability closure
        run: lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/verification/StatefulRoundingCertificateAudit.lean"
      - name: Replay probability source closure through the kernel
        run: python3 scripts/StatefulRoundingCertificateKernelCheck.py

      - name: Strictly compile recovered reference simulation
        run: lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/ImmutableReferenceSimulation.lean"
      - name: Strictly compile terminal accounting
        run: lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/ImmutableReferenceTerminal.lean"
      - name: Strictly compile concrete Boolean-table read
        run: lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/BooleanTableRead.lean"
      - name: Strictly compile packed Boolean construction and paid-index read
        run: |
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/PackedBooleanConstructor.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/PackedBooleanRead.lean"
      - name: Strictly compile actual binary budget construction

        run: lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/ImmutableReferenceSimulation.lean"

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/PackedBooleanConstructor.lean"

name: Lean
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - name: Check exact flow-cut source and runtime snapshot
        run: python3 scripts/CheckFlowCutRuntimeSnapshot.py
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
          axiom-audit: "true"
          axiom-audit-root: "VFTSpanners"
          axiom-audit-allow: "propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound"
      - name: Check all paper module indexes
        run: bash scripts/CheckModuleIndex.sh
      - name: Strictly compile the five repaired graph bounds
        run: |
          for module in BinaryFractionalWalkBounds BinaryFractionalGraphBounds BinaryFractionalGraphCost BinaryFractionalDispatchBounds BinaryFractionalGuessesBounds; do
            lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/DirectedFlowCutGap/$module.lean"
          done
      - name: Audit every declaration in all paper libraries
        run: lake env lean scripts/AxiomAudit.lean
      - name: Execute binary covering regression cases
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/verification/BinaryCoverEntrySmoke.lean"
      - name: Execute weighted packing and selection regression cases
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/verification/WeightedCombinedSmoke.lean"
      - name: Execute all eight recovered finite-data and binary graph bodies
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          runtime_log="$(mktemp)"
          trap 'rm -f "$runtime_log"' EXIT
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/verification/RuntimeGraphCombinedMain.lean" 2>&1 | tee "$runtime_log"
          python3 scripts/CheckRuntimeGraphResume.py "$runtime_log"
      - name: Replay every project module through the Lean kernel
        run: bash scripts/KernelCheck.sh

name: Zero-safe packing execution diagnostic
on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
      - name: Bind all inherited proof sources and new runtime fixture
        run: python3 scripts/CheckZeroSafePackingSnapshot.py
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          build-args: "+DirectedFlowCutGap.BinaryWeightedPacking"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
          axiom-audit: "false"
      - name: Execute three zero-safe packing fixture groups
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          runtime_log="$(mktemp)"
          trap 'rm -f "$runtime_log"' EXIT
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Improved Upper Bounds for the Directed Flow-Cut Gap/verification/ZeroSafePackingSmoke.lean" 2>&1 | tee "$runtime_log"
          python3 scripts/CheckZeroSafePackingOutput.py "$runtime_log"

name: LightEFT exact-source sequential gate
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source:
        description: Frozen exact source commit
        required: true
        type: string
      harness:
        description: Reviewed immutable verification-harness commit
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: paper-formalizations-single-compiler
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source }}
          path: tested
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.harness }}
          path: harness
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install hash-pinned official Lean
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p tested/ci-evidence
          {
            curl -fLSs --retry 3 https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/releases/download/v4.34.0/lean-4.34.0-linux.tar.zst -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/lean.tar.zst"
            echo "caaa98356098c85dc0fcbbd28e1ec66f39eb6551829972b752ff20e1286b646b  $RUNNER_TEMP/lean.tar.zst" | sha256sum -c -
            tar --zstd -xf "$RUNNER_TEMP/lean.tar.zst" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          } 2>&1 | tee tested/ci-evidence/toolchain-install.log
      - name: Clean exact-source strict compilation, replay and audit
        working-directory: tested
        env:
          SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ inputs.source }}
          HARNESS_COMMIT: ${{ inputs.harness }}
        run: python3 ../harness/scripts/LightEFTExactCI.py "$SOURCE_COMMIT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/lean-4.34.0-linux" "$HARNESS_COMMIT"
      - name: Preserve complete evidence, including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: light-eft-exact-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: tested/ci-evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
